scenarios.prompt: Scan this repository including generated build outputs for credential exposure.

expected.observable: supported text build artifacts are included and binary gaps remain explicit

scenarios.prompt: A generic secret-like assignment has a long high-entropy value but no provider/context proof.

expected.observable: entropy may support detection but does not alone set final high severity

scenarios.prompt: Two provider-shaped tokens occur on the same line.

expected.observable: two distinct redacted candidates with stable unique ids

scenarios.prompt: The secret was removed from HEAD but remains in Git history.

expected.observable: history review can detect it when Git history scanning is run

scenarios.prompt: Review a Dockerfile that passes a build credential through ARG.

expected.observable: flag unsafe build secret flow and prefer secret mount

scenarios.prompt: A Terraform variable is sensitive=true but can still persist to state.

expected.observable: do not equate display redaction with non-persistence

scenarios.prompt: An Agent Skill reads an API token and prints a debug object containing it.

expected.observable: review instruction+code flow and flag agent-visible stdout exposure without executing untrusted code

scenarios.prompt: A provider report says the exposed token is active.

expected.observable: use supplied validity for priority but do not authenticate with the token

scenarios.prompt: Working tree scanned clean, but Git history and remote CI logs were unavailable.

expected.observable: coverage-bounded conclusion, not blanket no-secrets claim
